statuses.supported: The current repository has a corresponding runtime implementation.
statuses.experimental: An implementation exists, but its public configuration contract is not stable.
statuses.awaiting_merge: Defined by the paper/UI contract; backend wiring must wait for the relevant branches to merge.

standard.notes: Existing registered environments cover the task family, but no unified experiment compiler consumes this contract yet.

safety.notes: Constraint implementations exist, but the paper taxonomy and a declarative JSON compiler are not yet unified. Power Spike also requires a final paper-level definition.

marl.notes: The existing MARL schema-v2 compiler is operational. A later exporter will translate the canonical UI contract into that format.
